A/B ROLE — a necessary condition for the hold (all three, in different words) versus falsification-only: falsification-only wins, because making R_ab >= 15% necessary hands the entire verdict to the one channel the designs concede they cannot blind, and their shared defence that a high R_ab 'grants nothing' is false on their own precedence tables.

A/B AGREEMENT TEST — 'same band' (minimal) versus '+/- 15 pp' (its own repair) versus 'R_ab must clear 30%' (precedent's repair): R_ab must clear B12's own frozen 30% before a hold stands, because 'same band' is unfalsifiable above 30% where every hold lives, and '+/- 15 pp' mints a tolerance while reusing an already-frozen number in the kill-only direction mints nothing.

MANIFEST SOURCE — enumerated from this repository's git history (precedent) versus authored and sealed (minimal, adversarial): authored, stratified, with the enumeration claim deleted, because the enumeration rule was MEASURED to fail here — 13 of the last 20 closed items touch only governance documents, all 7 code items touch the instrument itself, and both arms would run in a checkout containing the answer.

AMBIGUOUS OBSERVATIONS — excluded outright (minimal, adversarial) versus admitted: admitted to the FALL arithmetic at both bounds and excluded from the HOLD arithmetic, because crediting an unowned saving toward a hold is the double-count the refusal was built to prevent while dropping it from a fall is the withheld-read-as-low error STATE.md forbids by name.

R+ DOMAIN — over admitted observations (all three) versus over the full observation set: full set, granting every excluded observation its wouldHaveAdded, because admission clause 5 excludes exactly the observations R+ exists to protect, which made R+ arithmetically identical to R on every run the designs would have admitted.

TURN COLLAPSE — scored (all three) versus reported: reported only, because turns_collapsed is a caller argument on both tools (gate's `category`, repair's `max_rounds`) multiplied by the accumulated cache read the denominator counts once, so it can carry a hold on the term least connected to anything the tools did.

ACCEPTANCE DISAGREEMENT IN A PAIR — VOID the pair (all three) versus score it: score it and publish the 2x2, because acceptance is downstream of the treatment and voiding on it selects for pairs where the tools changed nothing, which makes the hold unreachable exactly in the world where the tools work.

ACCEPTANCE AS AN ADMISSION CONDITION — both arms (precedent) versus treated arm only: treated arm only for the primary instrument, because requiring both makes R's admitted set unknowable at the moment the verdict must be committed and lets a control-arm failure discovered weeks later silently redefine the set the committed number was computed over.

SHORTFALL BEHAVIOUR — exactly N with any drop voiding (minimal's repair) versus a floor of 20 (all three as written): an ORDERED manifest of 30 with the first 20 admitted scored, because the first rule discards nineteen good observations for one drop and the second lets n be chosen after the data, while a fixed order fixed in advance is neither.

THE ATTEMPT CAP — on restatements only, with counterfactual readings exempt as 'deterministic and re-runnable' (precedent) versus on runs: on registered runs, because determinism is a property of the arithmetic and not of the thirty fresh agent sessions that produce its input.

FALL APPEALABILITY — unappealable on the 'floor by construction' argument (all three) versus conditional: conditional, because that argument is false — refusal is a systematic deflator with a measured precedent of 534,443 units read as a confident zero — and a fall stops the project permanently, which is the worse of the two errors.

INSTRUMENT-CONTAMINATION SCOPE — per-observation void on reading any governance or instrument path (minimal, adversarial) versus run-level void on writing: run-level on WRITES, because a per-observation exclusion switch the operator can pull mid-task is a budget of result-aware discards, and the measured defect was one session that RAN the meter (83.5% of attributed units), not somebody reading a house rule this repository's own discipline requires them to read.
design.runPlan:
**PHASE 0 — INSTRUMENT REPAIRS AND HARNESS. ~4–6 sessions. Free, and only free now:** B20's rule applies verbatim — the implementation may be repaired until the first scored observation and is frozen absolutely after it, because there is no answer to tune toward until a residual exists. Ship the ten repairs in `detector` (signed suppression; `clientTruncationCap`; turn-collapse out of the scored numerator; `repair` credited once from the last round; `wouldHaveAdded` thread-resolved and nullable; `unmatched` given a magnitude and added to `refusedRows`; the per-`requestId`-subset accessor; lineage-aware `invocationOwners`; `unitsAddedByInstallation`; `scripts/b12-run.mjs`), the b12 emitter, and the six firing negative controls of VOID 6. Un-ignore `evidence/**`. **Cost of skipping this phase: the run cannot be re-emitted, cannot be corrected, and cannot be re-adjudicated — which is exactly how B1 died.**

**PHASE 1 — PRE-FLIGHT. One scratch session, ten minutes.** On the pinned binary, call `gate` once and `repair` once and assert `provenanceUnavailable === false`, `ambiguous === 0`, `unmatched === 0`, `excludedForeign === 0`, `savedFraction !== null`, and snapshot slug and id counts non-zero. It is the difference between losing ten minutes and losing forty-five sessions plus one of two attempts to a layout change or a path-scoping error. **The path-scoping error is the specific one this catches:** four worktrees exist, so four project slugs exist, the main checkout has zero `.jsonl` files and no telemetry file at all, and a run scored against the wrong tree returns a confident `0.0000` on every observation — a FALL, on the primary instrument, which fires G-stop immediately. This project already burned a commit on a confident zero.

**PHASE 2 — PILOT. 5 tasks, ~1 day.** Identical admission rules; the only committed output is the disposition distribution and the covariate vector. No units, no bracket — the verdict command cannot produce one on fewer than the manifest's N, so this is mechanically incapable of optional stopping. Declared in the pre-registration not to consume the attempt cap; its tasks are excluded from both sealed manifests. B20 needed four emissions to get a session-level number right; without a pilot the first run of new code is the scored one.

**PHASE 3 — `repair` EXPOSURE. ~2 sessions, and STATE.md already names it as the next action.** Route this project's own remaining mechanical work through `repair` before the manifest is sealed, so the delivery has exposure that is not manufactured by the experiment. `repair` is fully instrumented and has simply never been called; the fix is exposure, not code.

**PHASE 4 — PRE-REGISTRATION COMMIT. One session.** B12's text; manifests A and B both sealed and hashed in this commit; per task the base SHA, verification command strings, frozen `gate` `category`, frozen `max_rounds`, acceptance predicate verified to FAIL at that base commit, file scope, and both declared strata; `gate` run at each base commit with its output committed to prove the ≥ 3 mechanically-red tasks; `rates.json` asserted byte-identical to commit `3541625`; `claude --version` and binary sha256; the measured `clientTruncationCap`; the exact scoring command string; the pacing ceiling and per-task share cap; the arm-neutral in-repo CLAUDE.md and the out-of-repo per-arm policy blobs; the memory snapshot; and the attempt-register row in `MEASUREMENTS.jsonl` with `ts` read from the clock by the command that writes it.

**PHASE 5 — PRIMARY RUN. 20–26 supervised sessions, ~1–2 weeks at one person on one Windows box.** The harness drives it: worktree from the declared base, memory restored, version asserted, pre-snapshot, `claude --print --session-id`, post-snapshot, acceptance command, `obs-<NN>/` archived and committed BEFORE the next task starts. Ordered manifest of 30; the first 20 that admit are scored. `DISABLE_AUTOUPDATER=1` throughout; a version boundary splits the run into blocks rather than discarding it.

**PHASE 6 — VERDICT. One session, not in the manifest.** One scoring invocation over the ARCHIVE, never the live directory, using the committed command string. Emit `result.json` with the bracket, `R_hi⁺`, all five recomputations, the four strata, the three per-delivery figures with the asserted identity, both instrument-bias pairs, and the register of prior runs. Commit it. **This is the primary verdict and it is final at this commit.**

**PHASE 7 — A/B, AFTER the verdict commit. 12 sessions (6 pairs), ~3–5 days.** Pairs named in the same `tasks.json`, ABBA-counterbalanced, one worktree per arm from the same base, identical turn and wall-clock budgets, harness-driven to the committed acceptance command. Emit `ab.json` including `R_ab⁻ᵖ`, `R_ab_capped`, the paired mean and the 2x2. It can kill; it cannot grant.

**TOTAL: roughly 45–55 agent sessions and three to five weeks of wall clock, of which ~13 are pre-run and produce no answer.** That number is stated here so it is priced before the run and not discovered inside it, and it is what an honest version of this measurement costs. **The single largest thing that would cut it:** if `R_repair` proves unreachable in phase 3, B12 is measuring `gate` alone and the premise text should say so before phase 4 rather than after phase 6.

**AND THE OUTCOME THIS PLAN IS ALLOWED TO REACH:** two registered attempts, and if neither produces a bracket that clears a line, the recorded conclusion is that **G-stop is not evaluable in this venue** and the continue/stop decision is made on a stated non-metered basis. That is a real result. Reaching it honestly beats a third manifest chosen by what the first two taught.
